topSignals.title: Germany's EnEfG data-center rules were quietly eased in June - this digest has been carrying the stricter pre-amendment figures for two months
topSignals.text: The federal cabinet approved a draft reform of the EnEfG on June 25, 2026 that raises the long-term PUE target for new data centers from <=1.2 to <=1.3, scraps the waste-heat-use obligation for existing facilities entirely, and pushes the 100%-renewable-electricity deadline back three years to January 1, 2030. This digest's background line has repeated the original, stricter figures (PUE <=1.2 / ERF >=10% / 15% waste heat from July 2026) unchanged since June 24 without ever registering the amendment. LCOE implication: the CHP/waste-heat-recovery revenue driver for German SOFC deployments is now optional rather than mandatory for existing sites, and renewables-deadline pressure that would have favored SOFC-with-biomethane pathways is relaxed until 2030. Bill still needs Bundestag/Bundesrat approval. Clean Energy Wire | BMWE

topSignals.title: Energy Vault signs its largest-ever contract: 1.25 GW hybrid gas-genset-plus-battery off-grid platform for a Texas hyperscaler AI data center
topSignals.text: Announced August 7-10, the deal pairs Caterpillar gas gensets with Energy Vault's grid-forming BESS and AI power-management software to deliver fully off-grid power, explicitly designed to bypass ERCOT interconnection amid the state's new restrictions on data-center grid access. Energy Vault guides to $500-600M in revenue from the deal across 2H 2026 and 2027. This is a direct structural competitor to SOFC's off-grid pitch - a hybrid combustion-plus-storage system rather than a fuel cell - and worth tracking as a cost/deployment-speed benchmark. DCD | pv magazine | BusinessWire

topSignals.title: Fuel cell stocks diverge: FuelCell Energy +5% and Plug Power +4% on August 21 while Bloom Energy keeps slipping
topSignals.text: 24/7 Wall St. flagged a split in the "hydrogen trade" as FCEL and Plug caught a bid the same week Bloom continued its post-record slide (see August 22 digest entry). Separately, FCEL was upgraded to Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), with consensus earnings estimates up 22.1% over the past three months - a data point independent of data-center partnership news flow. No comparable move confirmed for Ceres; markets closed for the weekend as of this digest. 24/7 Wall St. | Simply Wall St

items.text: Elcogen (priority): Quiet day August 23. Status unchanged: E3000 G2 platform (>75% FC electrical efficiency, 90% with heat recovery, 650°C) in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn (360 MW/yr). No announcements since the June Ribera factory visit and the April JNK India MoU. Elcogen newsroom

Topsoe (priority): Quiet day August 23 on SOFC/SOEC specifically. Status unchanged: Herning SOEC factory hibernated, commercialization pursued via licensing deals only (First Ammonia; Sasol/Allied Biofuels methanol synthesis). SOFC data-center pathway remains deferred to 2029+. Topsoe.com

Other players: Quiet weekend. No new dated announcements from Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, or Sunfire beyond items already logged in prior digests.

Germany EnEfG easing (see Top Signal #1): Cabinet-approved June 25, 2026; still requires Bundestag/Bundesrat passage before it is final. Recommend updating this digest's standing background line to PUE <=1.3 (was <=1.2), no mandatory waste-heat reuse for existing sites (was 15%), and 100% renewables by 2030 (was 2027).

Background unchanged: PJM's BYONG/Large Load Registry filing (filed Aug 13, targeted Oct 12 effective date) - no FERC ruling found this weekend. FERC RM26-4 comment period open through ~September 16; ERCOT Batch Zero audit targeted for completion by December 2026; ITC 48E 30% credit active for all fuel cell feedstocks; 8+ US states with enacted data-center tax restrictions (last consolidated August 19).

Energy Vault 1.25 GW Texas hybrid deal (see Top Signal #2): Gas-genset-plus-battery, not pure SOFC or pure storage - the closest structural competitor to an off-grid SOFC pitch logged in this digest to date.

Gas turbine backlog, for context (not new news - Q2 2026 earnings cycle, first logged here): GE Vernova's slot-reservation backlog reached 116 GW by the end of Q2 2026 (up from 100 GW three months earlier), targeting 125 GW under contract by year-end. Siemens Energy's backlog stood at 69 GW at its fiscal Q3 close (June 30). Lead times of 3+ years at both suppliers continue to favor SOFC's faster deployment window for near-term (pre-2029) capacity. Turbomachinery Magazine | Power Engineering
No dated updates on the Rolls-Royce SMR GDA (DAC still pending, Q4 2026/Q1 2027 estimate unchanged) or other hyperscaler nuclear deals this weekend.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL) / Plug Power / Bloom Energy divergence (see Top Signal #3): FCEL +5%, Plug +4% on August 21; Bloom continued slipping. FCEL upgraded to Zacks Rank #2 (Buy); consensus EPS estimates +22.1% over three months. 24/7 Wall St.

Bloom Energy (BE): No material change from the August 22 entry - trading around $200, down roughly 49% from the August 12 record. Scandium class-action lead-plaintiff deadline September 28; 10-Q with MW-shipped/ASP detail due September 11.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new corporate news this weekend. Goldman Sachs' "top European pick for August" call (168% upside forecast) remains the live storyline heading into H1 2026 results (September).

lcoe.text: Germany CHP/waste-heat driver weakened (see Top Signal #1 and Regulations): The waste-heat-reuse mandate that would have applied to existing German data centers is being scrapped, and the 100%-renewables deadline pushed to 2030. Any LCOE scenario that priced in a German regulatory-compliance premium for SOFC CHP/heat-recovery should be revisited - the near-term case in that market now rests on economics and deployment speed alone, not compliance necessity. Still needs Bundestag/Bundesrat passage before final.

Off-grid hybrid benchmark (see Top Signal #2): Energy Vault's 1.25 GW Texas platform (gas gensets + BESS + controls) is guided to $500-600M revenue for the EPC/integration scope across roughly 18 months - a rough $400-480/kW revenue-run-rate comparator for off-grid power-infrastructure integration, distinct from generation-only capex figures already in the model. Not directly comparable to SOFC $/kW without adjustment (excludes genset hardware, which Caterpillar supplies separately).

(2) PJM BYONG docket, FERC action ahead of the October 12 effective date. (3) FERC RM26-4 comment period close (~September 16). (4) NMED September 14 Project Jupiter hearing, contingent on the Court. (8) Bloom Q3 2026 earnings (October). (9) Rolls-Royce SMR GDA DAC (Q4 2026/Q1 2027 estimate). (10) Germany EnEfG amendment - Bundestag/Bundesrat timeline not yet public.
